Overview.Name: Monica
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (small portion) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (80 g paneer) + vegetable curry
Evening_Snack: Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (2 cups, lightly salted)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + chicken curry (small portion)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + egg curry (2 eggs)
Option 3: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Since appearance is a major goal, keep rice controlled and make protein the main part of every meal.
Start every meal with chicken, egg or paneer before touching rice.
For sweet or fried cravings, eat full protein first and wait 10 minutes before deciding.
Avoid eating after 9 pm. Late-night eating slows fat loss.
Stress and boredom increase overeating. Keep fixed meal timings to reduce random snacking.
With consistency, expect steady fat loss around waist, thighs and face over 10–12 weeks.
